instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. On an outdoor cobblestone path next to a rustic stone wall, the smiling woman in the polka-dot dress (R2) on the left stands close and holds hands with the man in the brown fedora and white shirt (R1) on the right. The man stands facing her in profile, holding his silver saxophone in his other hand. Natural daylight illuminates the scene with warm tones, capturing their happy expressions and the green foliage behind them.
